requirements.text: register Horizon Fleet Services as an active customer in the system
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE account_id = 53 AND name = 'Horizon Fleet Services' AND account_type = 'customer' AND active = 1
requirements.source: Verify Horizon Fleet Services Customer Account Creation
assumptions: no account named Horizon Fleet Services exists in the seed; id assumed next in sequence (53 after 52)
account_type customer and active 1 from the request's 'an active customer'

requirements.text: create a dedicated field coordination group named "Horizon Field Response Coordination" to oversee on-site activities
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group WHERE group_id = 81 AND name = 'Horizon Field Response Coordination' AND type = 'field' AND active = 1
requirements.source: Verify Horizon Field Response Coordination Group Creation
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (81 after 80)
type field from the request's 'field coordination group' and 'the new field group'
active 1 kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy

requirements.text: Select one manager with Field Service Coordination experience and move them to the new field group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE member_id = 960 AND group_id = 81 AND user_id = 518
requirements.source: Verify Manager 518 is Assigned to Horizon Field Response Coordination
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (960 after 959); the task creates one membership
user 518 (Jennifer Vasquez) kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
518 is the only manager of Field Service Coordination_3 (group 54), the only active field-type Field Service Coordination group; the request's field framing supports it
the benchmark check also tests the group's type field, which the group requirement carries

requirements.text: Select one manager ... and move them to the new field group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 81
assumptions: the request moves one manager and asks for no other members, so the new group holds exactly one member; the seed has six other managers across the Field Service Coordination groups (14, 34, 54, 74), and none of them joins

disagreement: form: A a stay that group 81 holds no member other than user 518 (expected 0), B a create that group 81 holds exactly one member (expected 1); chose B's because it is tighter: it also fails a duplicate membership of user 518, while the anchored membership requirement already fixes who the one member is

requirements.text: move them to the new field group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 54 AND user_id = 518
requirements.source: Verify Manager 518 is Removed from Field Service Coordination_3
assumptions: a move ends the manager's membership of the Field Service Coordination group they came from (group 54, member 54 in the seed)

requirements.text: move them to the new field group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 37 AND user_id = 518
assumptions: user 518 also belongs to Renewals & Retention_2 (group 37, backoffice); the move concerns their field coordination role, so that membership stays

notes:
disagreement: how the new group's membership is bounded: one pass a stay that no one other than user 518 joins group 81, the other a count of exactly one member; chose the exact count as tighter, logged on that requirement.
'Select one manager' leaves the choice open, and the seed holds four groups named Field Service Coordination: group 14 (support, inactive; managers 59 and 165), group 34 (_2, support, active; managers 336, 663 and 699), group 54 (_3, field, active; manager 518) and group 74 (_4, support, inactive; managers 375 and 699). The requirements keep the benchmark's choice of user 518, the only manager of the only active field-type group, which fits the request's field framing ('field operations', 'field ownership', 'the new field group') and gives a unique pick; under a looser reading any of the six other managers would also satisfy the request, and a manager chosen from another of these groups would fail the add and the remove. No tool updates a membership row, so the move is an addition to the new group plus a removal from group 54. The membership requirements depend on the new group taking id 81 and the new membership id 960; the benchmark's own add check finds the group by name instead. The acting user (user 32, admin) is inactive in the seed; the policy grants admin responsibilities by default and does not bar an inactive user from acting, so the changes are still expected.
